recoveries.detail: Turning in place to face along the route: 177 deg to correct, holding up to 40 steps.

Replanned a 6-waypoint route to the goal via the visibility graph, now accounting for the obstacle that trapped the robot. The new route leaves 130 deg from the robot's heading, so it turns to face it first (holding up to 40 steps).
